blocks.signature: void skip() { while (pos_ < s_.size() && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(s_[pos_]))) ++pos_; }

blocks.signature: bool eat(char c) { skip(); if (pos_ < s_.size() && s_[pos_] == c) { ++pos_; return true; } return false; }
